commits.body:
Ship the review UI, skill, and hosting work since 0.7.0.

UI
- URL hash is the UI location (#overview, #group/<id>, #unassigned, #lockfiles), so a refresh or a shared link opens the same view
- Header group nav with next and previous; [ ] stays inside the current part
- Parts and dependsOn navigation; dependents labeled Needed by
- lookFor and sources as scan-and-jump lanes; Overview shows whole-change lookFor; hops style as links
- Source gists wrap; opening a shared source prefers the current group
- System theme uses a smartphone icon on mobile; larger type

Skill
- Document lookFor for whole-change and missing-work claims
- Pins npx comprehende@0.8.0
- GitHub Pages publish lives in the pages skill, not comprehende

Hosting
- PR reviews at https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/<number>/
- Named sites at https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/site/<name>/

AGENTS.md now requires those notes in the release commit body.
